blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Fundamental Duties serve as moral obligations reminding citizens that rights come with responsibilities.
They were incorporated into the Constitution via the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976.
The concept was inspired by the Soviet Constitution.
While originally 10 in number, one additional duty was added by the 86th Amendment Act in 2002, bringing the total to 11.

blocks.content: 10. Origin and Number of Fundamental Duties

items: Remember that Fundamental Duties were NOT in the original Constitution; they were added by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976.
Note the source of inspiration: Soviet Constitution.
Pay attention to the count: Originally 10 duties were added; the 11th duty was added by the 86th Amendment Act, 2002.

blocks.content:
• Introduced by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976.
